content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. content_sections.text: Project Technical Assistant: Master in Public Health OR Master of Social Work / Postgraduate in Social Sciences / Anthropology / Psychology. Desirable: Exposure to field-based health surveys, Good communication skills in English and Hindi.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Project Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhubaneswar (AIIMS Bhubaneswar) for filling project-based positions in the healthcare field.

faq.question: Q2. What post is being offered in this AIIMS Bhubaneswar notification?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bhubaneswar is hiring candidates for the position of Project Technical Assistant under a specific research project running in the CM & FM Department.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Project Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Technical Assistant post under this recruitment notification released by AIIMS Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master in Public Health OR Master of Social Work, or a Postgraduate degree in Social Sciences, Anthropology, or Psychology to be eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is set at 35 years, with age relaxations applicable to reserved category candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered for Project Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: Selected candidates appointed as Project Technical Assistant will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 35,000/- for the duration of the project.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of selection for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process is entirely based on a walk-in interview conducted in offline mode at the designated campus address in Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in interview scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 10 October 2026. Candidates must report between 10 AM and 12 Noon at the interview venue.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at Room No- 317, 3rd Floor, CM & FM Department, Academic Building, AIIMS Bhubaneswar, Sijua, Post: Dumuduma, Bhubaneswar - 751019.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring educational certificates, mark sheets, date of birth proof, ID proof, passport-size photographs, and one set of self-attested photocopies of all documents.
